turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! Hope your Monday is starting off well. How are things at the outpatient clinic today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! It's a pretty busy Monday, but I'm surviving. I decided to keep it simple this morning and just made a standard pot of classic drip-brew coffee at home before heading out.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Sometimes a simple brewed coffee is exactly what you need to kickstart the week! Did you skip trying out your roommate's new espresso machine today then?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Haha, yeah, I didn't want to deal with steaming milk and grinding beans when I was running a bit late. I had to rush out the door to catch the local light rail train to get to work.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Smart move, the rail is usually much less stressful than driving when you're in a hurry anyway. Did you have some time to listen to anything on your ride in?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I actually did! I finally put on my headphones and started listening to that real-life murder-mystery series my coworker recommended a while back. It's really gripping.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, the true-crime one! I'm glad you finally got a chance to check it out. Did it make the commute fly by?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It really did! Before I knew it, I was at my stop. And then work was non-stop until lunch. I just sat down to eat a turkey and Swiss sandwich I made using a couple of slices of my home-baked wild yeast bread.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds delicious. There's nothing like a sandwich on homemade sourdough. Have you had much time for baking or your other hobbies lately?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I managed to do a bake over the weekend, which is where this loaf came from. Salsa dancing has been on the back burner for a couple of weeks, but Tom and I are hoping to get back to a class soon.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A fresh weekend bake is a great way to prep for the week. I hope you and Tom get to hit the dance floor again soon! Do you have a relatively quiet afternoon ahead at the clinic?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fingers crossed! We have a few more patient appointments scheduled, but hopefully, it'll be a smooth afternoon. I should get back to it, but I'll talk to you later!
